teiHeader.author: Nathaniel Christen
teiHeader.description:
A list of sample sentences discussed in the paper
Ordering Conceptual Synthesis: The Implications of Cognitive Phenomenology for Syntactic Theory (https://scignscape.github.io/Rinc-XOA/authors/NathanielChristen/OrderingConceptualSynthesis.pdf)

text.s: My brother has been married for 10 years, but in many ways he's still a bachelor.
All of the eligible bachelors in this town are married.
Everyone sang along to three songs.
All appeals are heard by a panel of three judges.
All New Yorkers live in one of five boroughs.
All New Yorkers complain about how long it takes to commute to New York City.
In Ariel's picture of Beatrice, she looks sick.
In Ariel's picture of Beatrice, she snapped the lens just as two cardinals flew by.
We operated near the bank.
On the mantle was a wooden bat.
Every band performed three songs.
Everyone sang along to some song or another.
This election is slipping away from the Democrats.
Student after student came by to complain about the reading assignments.
John poured water onto the stove.
John spilled water onto the stove.
I put Mom's chocolate brownies in this red tin box, take some!
I'm heading out to the store.
Where are you going? Out to the store.
What are you doing? Heading out.
Last weekend we donated a hundred dollars to the animal shelter.
We gave the animal shelter a hundred dollars.
That newspaper just moved to 10th street and laid off half its staff.
At home you can print out this book from a PDF link.
The borough of Queens voted heavily for Mamdani.
These flowers really want some sunshine.
This drought has left the soil parched.
Our car stubbornly refused to move.
The spell-checker thinks "hooman" isn't a word.
